 Chipotle launches ‘Sneak It In’ hoodies with hidden pouch to keep your burrito warm
 The oversized unisex sweatshirt comes in three colors and includes a separate pocket for napkins

 By Stepheny Price FOXBusiness close video Food prices dropping under Trump, Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins says 
 Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins joins Dagen McDowell to discuss the decline in key food prices under President Donald Trump. Rollins highlights the easing of food inflation and drops in beef prices after months of progress.
 Chipotle is giving moviegoers a new way to keep their dinner under wraps.
 The restaurant chain announced Monday that it is launching a "Sneak It In" hoodie with a hidden, insulated pocket designed to carry a burrito or another entrée into movie theaters, according to a company release.
 "saw u sneaking burritos into the movies so we made a hoodie to help u out," Chipotle wrote in a post on X announcing the collection.
 YOUR NEXT SHIRT COULD HAVE A BUILT-IN TOUCHSCREEN 
 The unusual design drew eager responses from some social media users.
 "Insane, but I want one," one user wrote.
 "Stop it. Send one my way!" another added.
 Footwear brand HEYDUDE also chimed in, writing, "now this is a need."
 The limited-edition sweatshirt goes on sale Nov. 18 at 9 a.m. PT exclusively at ChipotleGoods.com . It costs $53 with free shipping and includes a free entrée card, the company said.
 The concealed pocket can fit a burrito, bowl, salad or tacos and is designed to help keep the food warm until showtime. There is also a separate pocket for napkins.
 CHRISTOPHER NOLAN'S 'THE ODYSSEY' UNCORKS A TROJAN HORSE POPCORN BUCKET THAT STORES THE GOODS IN ITS CROTCH 
 Chipotle’s "Sneak It In" hoodie features a hidden, insulated pocket designed to hold a burrito or another entrée and help keep it warm until showtime, according to the company. (Chipotle Mexican Grill) 
 Chipotle said the idea came from fans who were already bringing their orders to movie screenings.
 "Movie nights deserve real, craveable food. And since our fans were already sneaking Chipotle to theaters, we figured we'd make it a little easier," Kirby Ann Connell, Chipotle’s senior director of social and influencers, said in the release.
 "Sometimes innovation is as simple as putting a burrito pocket in a hoodie."
 The oversized, unisex sweatshirt comes in "Nothing To See Here Black," "No Burrito Here Brown" and "Got the Goods Gray."
 WENDY'S REVIVES NOSTALGIC YELLOW PACKAGING AFTER IT SPENT DECADES AWAY 
 Moviegoers enjoy snacks while seated inside a movie theater. (Ethan Miller/Getty Images / Getty Images) 
 The company cited a 2024 YouGov survey that found 63% of Americans said they had sneaked food or drinks into a movie.
 The hoodies will be available in the United States and Canada while supplies last, according to Chipotle. The included entrée card expires Dec. 31, 2027, and is subject to the terms printed on the card.
 CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP 
 U.S. Chipotle Rewards members can also enter a hoodie sweepstakes from Nov. 16 through Nov. 22 by exchanging 10 points per entry, with a maximum of 20 entries. A free entry method is also available, according to the company’s promotion details.
